page.layout: One printed page: a single centred column of chapter headings under the title "Index Capitum." on the right half of the scan. The left margin is blank. Below the list, a framed box holds the word "SCVTVM". No running head, page number, catchword or signature.
page.notes: The "SCVTVM" line sits inside a framed box in the lower part of the column, set apart from the list; I have kept it as a separate line. The long s is transcribed as plain s throughout, so "praestita" and "Haeresim" are read from the long-s forms. "Phocæ,Mauritij" is copied without the space the printer may have intended. Faint show-through in the lower left of the page was left out.
